insights: Jeans as the centre of the outfit
Queries often start from the jeans to build a look: tops to pair with them, a denim skirt, tulip jeans with stretch.
Build messages around the complete outfit: « The 501 and the top that goes with it ».
Levi's accounts for 41.1% of searches naming a brand, and the 501 Original Fit is the only model cited.
Make the 501 the lead product of the campaign.

Keep ad presence and strengthen brand content to win back spontaneous recommendations.
